dh02_state_grammar: ARMED requires a causally known eligible boundary and parent context that permits breakout research.
BROKEN follows only after an armed boundary receives a completed-bar directional break.
ENTRY_ELIGIBLE still requires context rules to remain valid.
One boundary plus one original break direction defines one event; repeated ticks do not create duplicate events.
dh01_context: CONFLICT_CHOP is a categorical state where direction signs and efficiencies conflict without a clear parent/pullback relationship.
Lower-timeframe disagreement is descriptive and not automatically disqualifying.
All context inputs are causal completed-bar values.
source_grounding.provenance_gap: The historical producer bytes are unavailable, so exact placement of conflict-only veto inside ARMED/boundary ownership is not preserved.

closed_by_11a_11b: dual-side versus single-global active event concurrency does not change the 11A signal population
one/two/three confirming ticks do not explain the 31-trade excess
simple continuous conflict invalidation after break does not change executable signal fingerprints

diagnostic_profiles.name: CONTROL_BREAK_REBREAK_CONTEXT
diagnostic_profiles.explanation: 11B next-tick control; context veto only at break/rebreak decisions.

diagnostic_profiles.name: BOUNDARY_REVEAL_ELIGIBILITY
diagnostic_profiles.explanation: A newly causally confirmed swing becomes an eligible/armed boundary only if parent context permits breakout research at reveal.

diagnostic_profiles.name: PREBREAK_DISARM_ON_CONFLICT
diagnostic_profiles.explanation: A known boundary is initially eligible, but a later CONFLICT_CHOP transition before break disarms/consumes that boundary until a new swing boundary is revealed.

diagnostic_profiles.name: REVEAL_ELIGIBILITY_PLUS_PREBREAK_DISARM
diagnostic_profiles.explanation: Boundary must be context-eligible at reveal and remains armed only while parent context continues to permit breakout research before break.

selection_rule: Carry forward only a source-grounded state placement that materially reduces the 31-trade excess and gross-loss excess without a compensating collapse in raw-positive winners; exact historical truth is not claimed from same-sample fit alone.
